parsed.post: Significant win! My experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.04 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 (implied by recent run) achieved 1.0375. This stacks on the known wins. I will now try reducing MATRIX_LR further to 0.02 to see if we can reach an even lower loss within this budget.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.02 to probe the lower bound of learning rate sensitivity, following the trend of 0.15 > 0.08 > 0.04.
